description: A planet under a physically based atmosphere, ported from Expansion (its Atmosphere and AtmosphereShader, after Maxime Heckel's "On rendering the sky, sunsets and planets" and Sébastien Hillaire's LUTs): each pixel's ray through the air's shell marched against Rayleigh's and Mie's scattering and ozone's absorption, the sun's light at each point read from a transmittance LUT made once on the CPU. A blue limb on the day side, reds along the terminator, the night side's city lights (Material.emissiveNight), a moon and stars.

The atmosphere is the example's own code, drawn at the renderer's AfterOpaque injection point; the surfaces are painted from noise at start. Drag to orbit, pinch or scroll to zoom; the presets switch Earth, Mars, a toxic world and an ice world, SUNRISE puts the sun just behind the limb, STATS shows the overlay.
credits: Atmosphere: Expansion's (benmerckx/expansion), after Maxime Heckel and Sébastien Hillaire
Surfaces painted from noise in code (MIT, helder)
